description: This source file implements a utility program that interacts with POSIX message queues to send a 'leak_check' message to a queue identified by a process ID entered by the user. It defines message queue attributes, constructs the queue name dynamically, opens the message queue, sends a message, and then closes the queue.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program that sets up message queue attributes, prompts for a process ID, constructs the queue name, opens the message queue, sends a 'leak_check' message, and closes the queue.
